name: Its your last chance in new school
source:
It happened this summer I came to the big city. In the city I did not know anyone. When I came the first time in school, I was afraid of their classmates. I thought they would make fun of me, but it was different, I met with the guys Kawasi, Batakun, Reyzi, Yuki, Ritka, Kolya.They have become my new friends.And one of the girls is not only a friend.

[From Steam (removed)]
translation:
那年夏天，我來到大城市。我在這裡一個人也不認識。第一次走進學校時，我害怕同學們會嘲笑我，但事情並非如此。我認識了Kawasi、Batakun、Reyzi、Yuki、Ritka和Kolya，他們成為我的新朋友。其中還有一個女孩，她對我而言不只是朋友。

（來源：Steam（已下架））
